data.name: Sianna
data.gender_notes: Sianna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Sian, meaning 'divine grace' or 'heavenly gift'. In Christian tradition, Sianna represents the blessings bestowed by God and the strength to overcome adversity. The name Sianna carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sianna usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Receiving and embodying the divine grace and blessings.
data.etymology: Sianna belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sianna total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: סיאנה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא חנני, חסד אלוהים, מתנת אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: סיאנה הוא שם שמשמעותו אלוהים הוא חנני, חסד אלוהים, או מתנת אלוהים. השם קשור למושג החסד והאהבה האלוהית, ומשמש כזכר לחסד ולרחמים של אלוהים. השם נגזר משורשים עבריים הקשורים למושגים של חסד ומתנה.

in_greek.name: Σιάνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Σιάνα σημαίνει Χάρις Θεοῦ ή Δωρεὰ Θεοῦ. Το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της χάριτος και της αγάπης του Θεού, και χρησιμεύει ως ανάμνηση της χάριτος και του ελέους του Θεού. Το όνομα προέρχεται από ελληνικές ρίζες που σχετίζονται με έννοιες χάριτος και δώρου.

in_latin.name: Sianna
in_latin.long_meaning: Sianna significat Dei gratia vel Donum Dei. Nomen coniungitur cum conceptu gratiae et amoris Dei, et servit ad memoriam gratiae et misericordiae Dei. Nomen derivatur ex radicibus latinis quae referuntur ad conceptus gratiae et doni.
